requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with Enhanced Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop and integrate NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield. CMY bottles must have a size supporting >8K pages.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses market demand for higher yield consumables and competitive positioning against CISS systems.
requirements.Dependencies: Bottle design, Tank size optimization, IDS integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles must be keyed, Black yield >= 6000 pages, CMY yield >= 6000 pages, CMY bottle size supports >8000 pages, validated via yield testing.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Bottle Reliability
requirements.Description: Ensure the new ink bottle system provides spill-free operation during all customer interactions and refills.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes mess and customer complaints, critical for CISS market acceptance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: During user testing, no ink spills observed in 100 consecutive refill operations.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate a new NOA-F (Non-OEM Authentication Filter) featuring a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, with no change to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances anti-counterfeit and authentication measures while maintaining current user experience.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F part design, integration with bottle and printer
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F passes security validation, metal foil and lid label present, click-on push-push and TDF unchanged.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Enable customer replaceability for PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F components.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability, reduces support costs, and meets market expectation for user-maintainable printers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customers can successfully replace PHA and NOA-F in field tests without technical intervention.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: The printer must support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with competitive market offerings and reduces total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Component durability, maintenance schedule, consumables yield
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device warranty supports 80,000 pages as measured by internal page count and verified through accelerated life testing.

requirements.Title: Speed: 25/20ppm (PDL: 25/19ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must achieve print speeds of 25 pages per minute (ppm) and 20 ppm, with PDL (Page Description Language) speeds at 25/19 ppm.
requirements.Rationale: Meets market standards for throughput and competitive positioning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified speeds in ISO standard print tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Touch Panel
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphics Display) touch panel for user interface.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user interaction and aligns with contemporary printer UI expectations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD is responsive, displays all required functions, and passes usability testing.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management for Tank Platform
requirements.Description: Implement aerosol management in the service station to accommodate changes due to the ink tank platform.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and maintains print quality and reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels remain within HP safety and quality limits during extended operation.

requirements.Title: Paper Path for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign the paper path to support increased page life requirements, in line with new warranty goals.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures hardware durability and consistent print quality over extended use.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components pass durability tests for 80,000 pages without failure.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part Post 80k Life
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance components to be serviceable at service centers after 80,000 page life is reached.
requirements.Rationale: Extends product lifespan, reduces e-waste, and supports post-warranty service models.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service centers can replace ink maintenance parts in under 30 minutes with standard tools.

requirements.Title: IDS with New Make-break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and fluidic interface (FI) connection in the IDS (Ink Delivery System), leveraging LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI (Level of Ink) One SHAID.
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability, prevents cross-contamination, and supports larger tanks.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS passes reliability and compatibility tests, supports new tank and bottle sizes.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new startup algorithm for the IDS that includes improved air management.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent print quality and reduces startup failures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup success rate >99% and air bubble incidents <0.1% during validation.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Set new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion metrics to align with updated page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures competitive print quality and accurate consumable life predictions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Print quality meets or exceeds HP PQ standards; depletion metrics align with 6K/8K yield claims.

requirements.Title: Compliance with EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel (PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Ensure product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certifications for environmental and energy requirements, specifically for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Required for market access and sustainability commitments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel prior to launch.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Redesign input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize overall device size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures paper handling reliability and compact footprint.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays operate reliably with tank protrusion; device size meets optimization targets.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam packaging for product shipment.
requirements.Rationale: Provides adequate protection during shipping and supports cost-effective packaging.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes drop and vibration tests with EPS foam packaging.

requirements.Title: Support for SMB and Enterprise Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate SMB manageability and enterprise support features including WJA, HPSM, and JAM solutions.
requirements.Rationale: Meets business customer requirements and enables fleet management.
requirements.Stakeholders: SMB Customers, Enterprise IT, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device is compatible with WJA, HPSM, JAM and passes solution interoperability tests.

requirements.Title: Support for PaaS and WorkFromHome/Flexworker Services
requirements.Description: Enable Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and support for WorkFromHome/Flexworker business models.
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and supports new business models.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS and WorkFromHome/Flexworker services are available and functional at launch.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 technology on the printer lid.
requirements.Rationale: Supports advanced authentication and/or analytics features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 functionality verified in system integration tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Hi PDL and Associated Electronics
requirements.Description: Leverage the Marconi Hi PDL platform and associated electronics (Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU, Stingray Wi-Fi module, Dune FW, Gauss4.xx security).
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and risk; accelerates time-to-market.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All electronics reused from Marconi Hi PDL operate as expected in Magellan platform.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer Onboarding Paths
requirements.Description: Enable onboarding via Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP paths.
requirements.Rationale: Facilitates a seamless onboarding experience for all customer segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customers can onboard via all specified paths without errors.

requirements.Title: Support for HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD Clients & Drivers
requirements.Description: Ensure compatibility and support for HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Maximizes interoperability and ease of use for customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers function correctly with the device.
